handover_report.title: EverythingAI Phase 8.3B Shared Preview Release Hardening Handover
handover_report.branch_policy: Work directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.
handover_report.summary: Phase 8.3B continued safe frontend hardening by centralizing extracted text preview rendering and preview text selection across Client Workspace and Admin Dashboard while preserving runtime behavior and all governance boundaries.

details: Moved extracted preview text selection into the shared component.
Client ExploreView now passes documentContext to the shared preview component.
Admin ExplorerView now passes selectedPreview to the shared preview component.
Shared preview style remains centralized in apps/everything-ai-ui/src/shared/extractedTextPreviewStyle.ts.
Preview source typing remains centralized in apps/everything-ai-ui/src/shared/selectExtractedPreviewText.ts.
Created validation artifact for the shared preview component batch.
Created release checklist addendum after the parent checklist update was blocked by the GitHub connector safety layer.

latest_local_validation.summary: GREEN - git pull PASS, typecheck PASS, build PASS, smoke PASS

governance_boundaries_preserved: Client Workspace and Admin Dashboard separation preserved.
Provider selection, API keys, remote-provider policy, and planning policy remain admin-only.
Agent bridge execution remains disabled by default.
Agent chat execution remains disabled by default.
No arbitrary browser shell execution was enabled.
No backend, API, schema, connector, or agent execution behavior changed.
known_notes: The GitHub connector blocked a full replacement update to docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST_2026-06-14_PHASE8_3B.md, so a separate addendum was created instead.
The GitHub connector also blocked creation of a TSX variant of ExtractedTextPreview; the working component was created as a .ts file using React.createElement.
recommended_next_steps: Continue small frontend modularization batches only after reading this handover and the previous Phase 8.3A handover.
Avoid broad refactors and avoid changing backend/API/connector behavior unless explicitly approved.
Consider richer citation/source highlighting polish as a future separate batch.
